I believe that schools should establish an after-school homework club because many students find it difficult to complete their assignments on their own. Often, students do not fully understand the instructions, but if they had a club to attend, many more of them would finish their work. While some might think homework is not important, it usually accounts for about 10 percent of a student's grade. This might seem like a small amount, but it can significantly improve a final result. Furthermore, completing homework is the best way to prepare for tests. A single assignment could provide the knowledge needed to pass a quiz that a student might otherwise fail.

Middle school is a challenging time because students have to manage seven different classes. It is not easy to keep up when every teacher provides one, two, or even three pieces of homework at the same time. If students do not understand the initial lesson in class, it is difficult for teachers to expect them to finish the work at home without any guidance. In a homework club, students could ask for clarification on topics they found confusing. Teachers would be there to explain the concepts properly, ensuring that students actually learn the material rather than just searching for the right answers. This support could easily help a student raise their grade from a B to an A.

This program would benefit the entire school community. When students complete their work and get better grades, the school’s overall performance looks much better. It also helps students who are capable of doing the work but struggle with organization or turning assignments in on time. For those with busy schedules, staying after school for a dedicated period could be exactly what they need to get caught up.

In conclusion, a homework club would be a valuable addition to any school because homework is a major issue for many students. Some people claim that homework does not matter, but it plays a vital role in academic success. Doing these assignments helps students master their subjects and perform better on exams. If this club existed, students would be much less stressed because they would not have to worry about a mountain of work at home. Once their assignments are finished at school, they are free to enjoy their afternoon, knowing their responsibilities are already met.

Ralph Waldo Emerson once stated that being yourself in a world that is constantly trying to change you is the greatest accomplishment. I fully support this view. To accomplish something means to successfully reach a goal or fulfill a purpose. I believe that living an authentic life is the only way to achieve true success and satisfaction.

To illustrate this, consider the story of two women competing for a high-paying job as a company director. The company wanted a leader who appeared wealthy and successful. The first woman decided to create a false identity to get the job. She borrowed $500,000 from banks to buy luxury cars and houses, pretending to be a famous socialite. She believed that looking the part was more important than being herself.

The second woman was very different. She did not have much money, but she possessed great talent and many years of relevant work experience. Unlike her competitor, she did not try to hide her background or pretend to be rich. She remained humble and focused on her skills during the selection process.

When the time came to announce the winner, the woman living the fake life was certain she would be chosen. However, the judges revealed that they had discovered her lies. They explained that they could not trust someone who built their life on deception. They feared she would eventually embezzle money or ruin the company’s reputation. Consequently, the job was given to the honest woman, who achieved her dream by simply being herself.

This example shows that while the world may pressure us to act like someone else, faking your life only leads to failure and public disgrace. The greatest accomplishment is to stay true to your identity, as honesty and hard work will eventually lead to the fulfillment of your goals.

The best way of work.

One question has been asked during a long time. Is it better to work alone or to work in a group?

Most of the people and analysts have got the conclusion that working in groups could be more beneficial.

A factor the support this idea it is because you get to have different thoughts, ideas and ways to see the life that can help you in bad situations. For example, if you are planning either something as big as a school event, or something as simple as a classroom presentation, there is occasions when you run out of ideas. You can count in the group. They are going to be there giving diverse solutions to the problem, otherwise, by yourself you could be struggling like if you are in road with no exit.

Working in a group sometimes can make you relax, laugh and bring positivism, even in challenging moments or when you are facing stress. Every time you have to work in this way, you do not spend boring moments. There will be always something to talk about. You and your team would be saving memories that in a future would be a moment of laugh.

Another fact about working in group is that you get to finish the work in a faster. More people working in the a series of things in a quickly way than just one, makes a big difference. It will give space to the creativity, where you can practice more, give details to the work or even do new creations.

Because you are working in a team you do not focus only in "I" you open your mind and start thinking in "we". This is going to be useful in the future, when you go out to the real world. Working with other people, you have to deal with different personalities and thoughts. The team working abilities are going to be place in your mind.

When as a team all your tasks are completed you will find a great euphoria in the results. It is going to make everyone proud of themselves and also it is going to be a method to keep pushing them up and never give up.

Sometimes when you get to work in a group it might sound or seem a difficult task. But instead, you learned new experiences and new abilities. It become a helpful tool to develop character and to grow as a person. You have to learn how to speak with the people and how to tell your ideas in a clear manner. That is why many people agreed that working in teams brings more benefits than just working alone.

For a long time, people have debated whether it is better to work individually or as part of a team. Most experts and observers agree that collaborating with others offers more advantages.

One reason for this is the variety of perspectives a group provides. When facing a challenge, having different viewpoints can be very helpful. For instance, whether you are organizing a large school function or a simple presentation, you might run out of inspiration. In a group, you can rely on others to offer diverse solutions. In contrast, working alone can feel like being stuck on a road with no exit.

Furthermore, teamwork can make the process more enjoyable and less stressful. Working with others often leads to laughter and a positive atmosphere, even during difficult times. Instead of a boring experience, there is always someone to talk to, and these shared moments become pleasant memories for the future.

Another benefit is that tasks are usually completed much faster. When several people divide the work, they can finish more quickly than a single person could. This efficiency creates extra time for creativity, allowing the team to refine details or even develop new ideas.

Working in a team also changes your mindset from "me" to "us." This is an essential skill for the future and the professional world. By collaborating, you learn how to interact with different personalities and respect various opinions, which helps develop strong teamwork abilities.

When a project is finished successfully, the entire group feels a sense of pride and excitement. This shared success motivates everyone to keep improving and encourages them not to give up on future goals.

Although working in a group can sometimes seem challenging, it provides valuable experiences. It helps individuals build character, grow personally, and learn how to communicate their ideas clearly. Ultimately, these benefits explain why many people believe that teamwork is superior to working alone.

Often, people do not even want to change these impressions because they enjoyed the feeling and want to remember it.

A clear example of this is when you see someone on the street wearing very unusual clothing. This person immediately grabs everyone’s attention because they look different from what people are used to seeing. In these moments, people often form quick opinions. Some might judge the person based on their outfit, while others might feel curious and want to learn more about their culture or lifestyle. This initial reaction is powerful and shapes how we think about that person from then on.

We experience these types of impressions constantly because we are always surrounded by others, including family, friends, and strangers. No matter where we are, we are exposed to new things that trigger these immediate feelings. These moments are a natural part of life, and we often find ourselves sharing these stories with our friends or using them as examples in our own lives. Sometimes, a first impression can even inspire us to change ourselves for the better because we see something special in another person that we want to follow.

In conclusion, first impressions are generally impossible to change because they are one-of-a-kind experiences. While you might change your opinion later, the original feeling remains unique. If you meet the same person again, the experience is different because you already know what to expect. Ultimately, these first encounters help us understand the diverse lives and cultures of the people around us, showing us that everyone has something unique to offer.

I believe that distance learning offers significant advantages for students all over the world. This system allows individuals to participate in classes regardless of where they live, which is particularly helpful for those who reside far from their school and lack reliable transportation. Furthermore, studying from the comfort of home can make the learning process much more enjoyable and relaxed for many students.

One major benefit of distance learning is the ability to access high-quality education from different countries. Students can take specialized courses that might not be offered in their own local schools. For example, a student living in France could enroll in a program based in the United States to experience a different perspective and teaching style. This is also a great option for families who are living abroad temporarily and want to ensure their children continue with a specific curriculum before returning to their home country.

In addition, online education makes life much easier for those who face physical barriers to attending school. Some children have to walk for several hours through difficult terrain, such as mountains, just to reach a classroom. Online options provide a vital solution for those living in remote areas or regions with extreme weather. We also saw the importance of this during the COVID-19 pandemic; when schools had to close for safety reasons, distance learning allowed students to continue their studies from home without being at risk of getting sick.

Furthermore, some students feel very uncomfortable in a traditional classroom setting, which can cause them to lose interest in their work. At home, they often feel safer and more supported by their families. In many schools, bullying and peer pressure are serious issues that prevent students from being themselves or focusing on their education. There was a famous video of a seven-year-old boy who was so deeply affected by bullying that he no longer wanted to live. For children in such difficult situations, homeschooling and online classes provide a necessary escape and a more positive environment for their mental health.

However, whether distance learning is a good choice often depends on the individual. Some people argue that it is disadvantageous because students do not get enough opportunities to socialize. This can make it difficult for them to interact with others in person later in life. For instance, I have a friend who was homeschooled for a long time; now that he is in a regular high school, he is very quiet and finds it hard to make new friends. In conclusion, while social development is important, online education remains a fantastic benefit for those who want to study internationally, those with long commutes, or those who need a more comfortable and safe learning environment.

Recently, I had a very stressful experience during an early morning math exam. I woke up late and unfortunately missed the school bus, which forced me to walk the entire distance to campus. By the time I arrived, I was exhausted and anxious, which caused me to perform poorly on the test. If I had been enrolled in online classes, I could have taken the exam from the comfort of my home and avoided all that unnecessary trouble. I believe that online learning is a great option because it prevents these kinds of logistical problems and saves a significant amount of time for students.

Admittedly, some people argue that students do not benefit from remote learning. They suggest that it can be difficult to understand lectures or complete assignments without face-to-face interaction. For example, if a teacher assigns a complex project, a student might feel confused about the requirements or struggle to grasp a specific topic during a video call, which could negatively impact their academic performance.

However, the flexibility of attending classes from home is a major advantage. This format allows students to keep up with their studies even when they are sick or away from home. If I am feeling unwell, I do not have to miss an entire day of school; I can simply participate in the lesson from my house. Furthermore, if I am staying with a relative or a friend, I can still attend my classes from any location. This ensures that students stay on track with their education regardless of their circumstances.

In addition, online classes help high school students manage their time much better. By cutting out the daily commute, students gain extra hours that can be used for other important things, such as working a part-time job. This allows them to earn money and save for their future college expenses. Moreover, students can finish their school assignments more efficiently, giving them the freedom to take extra courses for their future careers or engage in hobbies they enjoy.

To conclude, online education is highly beneficial because it offers flexibility for students who are ill or traveling and provides more time for personal and professional growth. Not only does it help us avoid the stress of a traditional school schedule, but it also gives us the chance to pursue extra activities and enjoy our daily lives more fully.

Many people are pressured to decide on a career path before they even start high school. However, I believe that young adults should take their time with this significant life choice rather than rushing into it. Selecting a profession is a major milestone that depends on the individual’s maturity, and pursuing a specific career should be a personal choice rather than a forced requirement.

One reason I disagree with early career selection is that students often simply follow the instructions of adults. This can result in young people choosing paths they do not actually enjoy, which eventually wastes their time, money, and passion. Instead of being pressured, students need genuine inspiration to become doctors, teachers, or architects. Having the support of parents and family is also essential, as many students lose motivation when they do not have someone encouraging them to pursue their goals.

Furthermore, young people need more exposure to the professional world before making a commitment. It would be beneficial to watch videos or hear from people already working in various fields to understand their daily tasks. It is helpful to compare two different life paths: a person who completed their education and has a stable income, and someone who struggled because they did not finish their studies. Understanding that working in difficult conditions is not easy can motivate students to think more seriously about their future.

Most people want a bright future for themselves and their families. High school should be a time to discover what you truly enjoy. For instance, if a student loves drawing, they might be inspired to study architecture and design incredible buildings like those found in Dubai. Unfortunately, many people do not realize how vital education is for achieving these dreams.

Finally, some students leave school early to work because they lack financial or family support. To address this, we need special programs that demonstrate the benefits of staying in school. Education provides the knowledge and skills necessary for a better life, and everyone deserves the chance to see its value.

In our daily lives, we often make mistakes, both at work and in our personal relationships. These errors are not always intentional; instead, our emotions and changing circumstances frequently influence how we think and act. Whether we are meeting someone new or starting a career, every small detail can shift our perspective. This is a natural part of being human.

The ability to make our own choices is a fundamental human trait. It allows us to express our desires and feelings, which has led to incredible inventions and progress throughout history. When we decide for ourselves, we show what we are truly capable of achieving, building, and learning.

However, being independent does not mean we should always act alone. While autonomy is important, there are specific situations where we need guidance or must follow certain rules. For instance, in a courtroom, at school, or in a professional environment, our choices are often limited by laws or regulations. Similarly, children need help from adults because they are not yet ready to decide everything for themselves.

I believe that we should have the freedom to make our own decisions as long as we follow the rules of society. By doing so, we take full responsibility for our lives. It is important to remember that making a mistake is not a failure. Instead, it is an opportunity to learn and grow. Having the right to choose means having the right to fail, to try again, and to build the life we want. Ultimately, being free to make our own choices is what allows us to learn from our experiences and find our own path.

Conserving your energy it's an important matter. But you may be wondering why? well, by conserving your energy you will be well rested, healthier and more importantly active, so you can last on your long day of work or in my case school, so I can focus on my learning in order to graduate on time.

Recently, some business companies started to conserve their body energy by working less days, but having long shifts a day. 10 hours a day to be more specific. I personally think that, this is not exactly the right way to conserve your energy and keep your body healthier. On the other hand, I would agree that you would earn more money an have better opportunities in your career despite your personal life.

As far as I understand business companies like Management, Grocery stores, or car dealers have a 8 hour shift Including

Schools and government jobs etc...

If people would work 4 days a week and 10 hours a day It would totally not be good for their healthy and personal life.

As a result you would definitely be tired, exhausted and having a bad mood for not getting enough sleep. Second of all, when It comes to your personal life there would not be a family time, and no time to go out with friends therefore, I conclude that the concept of having a 10 hour shift a day would definitely not be that best way to live your life.

Dear Manager,

I am writing to you because I would like to visit your company to explore whether this career path is a good fit for me. I am interested in seeing the daily operations and learning exactly what the work involves.

Large companies are impressive because they employ many people to ensure that tasks are completed efficiently. By visiting, students could gain a realistic sense of what it is like to work in a professional environment or even hold a management position. It would be helpful to learn about the daily routine, such as working a seven-hour shift and knowing when to take lunch breaks. We would also like to see how the workspace is organized so that materials can be located quickly, ensuring that products are finished on time for customers.

Many people wonder about the logistics of running a large business. For example, I am curious about the physical limits of a company’s size and the costs associated with constructing a building. I would also like to know if facilities need to be renovated every five or six years and whether it is better to locate a business in an urban or rural area. Furthermore, understanding the supply chain is important. I want to learn how materials are delivered and how the money earned from sales is reinvested to help the company grow. Managing the costs of materials is essential to ensure the business remains profitable and avoids financial struggles.

There are also many questions regarding the challenges of running a business. For instance, how does a company handle expensive electricity bills or the risk of running out of supplies? If a company produces low-quality goods, they might face serious trouble. Successful companies often grow larger because they sell products quickly, allowing them to invest in better equipment and hire more staff. It is also important that every company creates its own products. If a business steals an idea from a competitor, they should face heavy fines or even jail time for such actions.

Additionally, I am interested in the working conditions for employees. I would like to know if the staff must work on festive holidays like Christmas or New Year, or if the machines are turned off during those times. Understanding policies regarding vacation days and sick leave is also vital. For example, if an employee is ill, should they call the manager immediately, or wait for the manager to contact them? It would also be interesting to know if a replacement is brought in when someone is sick. Finally, I am curious about safety and insurance, such as whether a company receives compensation if a fire destroys their equipment.

In conclusion, allowing students to visit your company would be a wonderful opportunity. It would help us understand the responsibilities of managers and employees, as well as how to manage money effectively to ensure a company's future success. This experience would provide everyone with a better perspective on the professional world.

Sincerely,

This issue is very common in high schools, where a huge number of students focus on gaining the approval of their peers. Teenagers are usually the most affected by this pressure. In many cases, they stop acting like themselves because they are so focused on how they appear to others.

My primary talents involve drawing, painting, and writing. These are more than just hobbies; they are my favorite ways to express myself. I enjoy creating cartoons, painting pictures, and writing stories. Last year, I focused heavily on art by joining various clubs and classes. Although I aspire to be a professional cartoonist, I decided to focus more on my writing skills this year. However, I plan to return to formal art classes in the ninth grade. Whenever I have free time at home or school, I use these creative skills to stay busy.

Regarding my writing, I hope to create books that everyone can enjoy. To improve my abilities, I recently attended writing classes over the summer. My experience is quite varied; last year, I contributed to the school newspaper by writing articles and drawing cartoons. I also participated in the animation club, where I drew scenes for different projects. Additionally, I joined the yearbook staff to write captions that explain the meaning behind the photos. I even applied my artistic skills in my home economics class to decorate cakes and cupcakes. These experiences have shown me that art is a perfect fit for my personality.

Writing is perhaps my most significant skill because it allows me to explore different themes. I particularly enjoy working on novels, such as my project based on the Transformers "Dark of the Moon" graphic novel. This story covers the war on Cybertron and the history of the space race. Beyond just plots, I love how writing captures specific words and deep emotions. I also enjoy writing poetry, as it is a great way to process and express feelings.

I believe writing is impressive because it combines facts, opinions, and creativity. It requires careful attention to vocabulary and spelling, which I always check after finishing an essay or an article. Furthermore, art and writing often work together. For instance, in graphic novels, authors must use speech bubbles to show what characters are feeling, whether they are happy or sad. They also use bold text to emphasize important points. This combination of images and language helps the reader understand the story's message more clearly.

In conclusion, I plan to keep developing my talents in the future because they are very meaningful to me. Whether I am drawing comics or writing stories, these skills will always be a central part of my life. I truly care about my creative work and look forward to continuing these activities as I grow older.

Ultimately, whether a game has positive or negative effects, people of all ages continue to play simply because it is a great way to have fun.

Can failure lead to success?

Former British Prime Minister Winston Churchill once said that "success consists of going from failure to failure without loss of enthusiasm."

Many people who have dreams and goals would agree.

If failure is on the road to success it will give motivation, thought of improvement, and an opportunity to have experience.

Failure doesn't always have to be a bad thing.

Failure will give people that push of motivation many need. If students fail once then they know they have to get up and keep trying. Are many people just going to give up because they failed one time? Let's say somebody is setting a high goal and fail; if that person sets a high goal they will have to understand failure will come in some part of that; it is a reach to get there. As soon as failure kick's in, so should the motivation. If not then nobody will be able to meet the goal of success they want. For example,student is walking into class and spent the whole night studying for this test.

She turns it in and thinks she did well. Turns out that it is the opposite. She has the chance to retake it and is taking the chance. Sometimes expectations don't go the way people would like. That doesn't mean eventually the expectation won't get met.

It just means to keep trying.

Another reason on why failure can bring success is because it gives thought of improvement. Everyone knows the saying "You learn from your mistakes". That saying is very true.

If something goes wrong because the way it was dealt with, will the same mistake happen again? Of course not! People see when the mess up or fail after it happens and will try to do better.

That is improvement and it's leading you to success.

Then we will know where to start and where to fix things.

It's apart of succeeding. People who have succeeded can tell others than without at least one fail, they would not of made it to where they are now.

Last but not least, it gives you experience.

If we didn't fail there would be no experience for the next goal. Having that experience of failure will help.

When the goal is met and finally succeeded then there will be an amazing story to tell. Especially because failure was around. Speak on the obstacles that were faced and how to get through without giving up. Having this experience and speaking about it can influence others as well. Maybe some people also have failed but they want to give up, encourage others that failing doesn't mean you still can't succeed.

To conclude, failure can be a big step to success if used the right way. Don't sit there and give up because failing is a way closer to the goal. Use failure as motivation, thought of improvement, and an opportunity to have an experience. In this case, failure is a great thing.

This demonstrates that failing is not a permanent state; it is simply a sign that more effort is required. If we accept that high goals come with risks, failure becomes the spark that keeps us moving forward.

Additionally, failure encourages self-improvement. There is a well-known saying that we learn from our mistakes, and this is certainly true in practice. When a plan fails, it forces us to analyze what went wrong so we do not repeat the same errors. This process of identifying and fixing problems is exactly what leads to progress. Many successful individuals admit that they would never have reached their current positions without the lessons they learned from their initial defeats.

Finally, failing provides us with valuable experience. Each setback teaches us how to handle obstacles, which prepares us for future challenges. Furthermore, overcoming these difficulties creates an inspiring story. When we eventually reach our goals, we can use our personal experiences to encourage others who might be struggling. By showing that it is possible to survive failure and keep going, we can influence others to stay persistent in their own lives.

In conclusion, failure should be viewed as a stepping stone rather than a barrier. If approached with the right mindset, it offers the motivation, growth, and experience needed to eventually succeed. Instead of giving up when things go wrong, we should embrace failure as a sign that we are getting closer to our objectives. In this sense, failing is actually a very positive thing.

I agree with Ralph Waldo Emerson’s idea that growth only happens when we attempt things that are outside our comfort zone. If we only do what we have already mastered, we will stay at the same level forever. To truly improve, we must set higher expectations for ourselves and be willing to try new challenges.

The first reason I support this view is that repeating the same easy tasks leads to stagnation. For instance, if I play on a recreational soccer team where there are no tryouts, I might be the best player and score in every match. While this feels good, I would not actually be getting better because the competition is too easy. To grow as an athlete, I would need to join a travel team where the players are more skilled. This higher level of difficulty would force me to work harder and improve my game.

Some people might be afraid to push themselves because they are scared of failing or being embarrassed. However, making mistakes is a necessary part of reaching a new goal. For example, if my goal is to score three goals in a single soccer match, I might not achieve it every time. Instead of giving up, I should see these moments as opportunities to learn. Since nobody is perfect, failing helps us understand our mistakes and motivates us to practice more.

Furthermore, it is important to try mastering different skills rather than just sticking to one thing. If you only focus on what you already know, you will never develop other talents. Being good at several different things makes life more interesting and gives you more options. Many people find that their interests change over time, so having multiple goals at once can help you stay motivated and versatile.

In conclusion, I believe Emerson is right about the necessity of pushing our limits. By setting higher goals, we ensure that we continue to grow. Even though we might fail along the way, those experiences teach us valuable lessons. By challenging ourselves and trying new things, we can become more capable and well-rounded individuals.

Although some educators suggest that schools should operate year-round with shorter breaks, I believe the traditional summer vacation should remain. The extreme heat makes it difficult to study, and students need this extended time for travel and employment.

The primary reason to avoid summer classes is the intense weather. High temperatures can make the classroom environment very uncomfortable. When it is extremely hot, students often experience physical issues like headaches and fatigue. This discomfort increases stress, which can lead to lower grades because it is nearly impossible to focus on complex lessons. Students are much more productive when they are not struggling with the heat.

In addition, the long break allows families to spend quality time together. Many people plan significant vacations or trips abroad during these two months. Since there is no school, students can enjoy these experiences without worrying about missing important lessons. Furthermore, summer is an ideal time for students to get a job. Without the burden of homework, they can dedicate their energy to earning money and learning responsibility.

To conclude, summer is a difficult time for academic work but a vital time for personal life. The government should not reduce this break because it is a necessary period for relaxation. After working hard throughout the school year, students deserve this time to recharge and enjoy their lives without the pressure of education.

Many educators and parents are currently debating whether year-round schooling is a beneficial idea. In my opinion, switching to this schedule would be a great move. The primary advantage is that it prevents students from forgetting everything they learned the previous year. By staying in school more consistently, we would have a better chance of understanding and remembering our lessons.

If we could remember our previous lessons, teachers wouldn't have to spend so much time reviewing old material at the start of every term. Instead, we could move quickly into new topics in subjects like Math, English, and History. Having more days in the classroom ensures that the information stays with us longer. Furthermore, getting extra help during these days would make us much more prepared for important exams and standardized tests.

I know from experience that it is difficult to remember how to solve specific math problems after a long summer break. Year-round school could fix this issue. Sometimes students lose focus because the traditional schedule is so long, but a year-round system might allow teachers to use different methods to keep us engaged. With more consistent time in class, we could stay more interested in what we are learning.

I support the idea of year-round school because of the many opportunities it offers for us to stay focused. While it is true that our summer vacation would be shorter than usual, we would receive more frequent breaks throughout the rest of the year. This balance would make it much easier to manage the large amount of information we are expected to learn.

Ultimately, I believe that a year-round schedule would be very successful. It would help many students feel more confident because they would remember the work from the year before. This would make classes feel easier and help everyone perform better on their assignments. It is a change that is definitely worth trying to see how much it can help us succeed.

I agree with Winston Churchill’s idea that success is built on failure. Being successful is often different from what people imagine; it is actually about solving problems and overcoming the challenges that block our path to self-improvement.

Becoming a successful professional often starts with choosing a career path at a young age. Since children tend to learn much faster than adults, starting early provides a significant advantage. From a young age, parents and teachers often encourage children to dream about their future roles, whether they want to be doctors, teachers, or engineers. Encouraging students to commit to a career goal early in life helps them stay focused on their long-term success.

Preparing for a professional career requires a great deal of time and dedication. Many paths involve difficult subjects, and students may sometimes need to retake classes to fully understand the material. For instance, becoming a doctor requires many years of education and a large financial investment. By starting early, families have more time to save money, or students can work toward earning government scholarships. Ultimately, achieving excellence in any field requires the time and deep knowledge that only long-term preparation can provide.

Furthermore, starting early gives students the opportunity to explore different options. If they begin their journey while they are young, they have the flexibility to change their minds if they discover a different field they enjoy more. This early start also allows them to research which careers offer better salaries and job security. By exploring various paths early on, students can eventually settle on the career that best fits their personal talents.

On the other hand, some people argue that young students lack the maturity to make such important life decisions. They believe children might only choose a job because they want to imitate a relative, like a parent or an uncle, without truly understanding the daily responsibilities of that job. Critics suggest that young people are not responsible enough to plan their entire futures. However, even if children are influenced by those they admire, starting early still provides a necessary foundation for their professional lives.

In conclusion, deciding on a career at a young age offers many benefits. It provides students with more time to learn, gain experience, and even correct their mistakes along the way. Those who begin working toward their goals early are often much better prepared for a successful future. Therefore, high schools should continue to encourage students to think about their professional paths as early as possible.

There are various methods to inspire those around us. It is not just about a person's general behavior, but rather about demonstrating clear goals and the drive to achieve them. For instance, in the film "The Princess and the Frog," the main character is determined to open her own restaurant to honor her father’s memory. Despite facing many obstacles, she works tirelessly to save enough money. Her story shows that having a specific objective and the determination to reach it is a powerful way to lead by example.

One primary way to influence others is through our physical actions. Doing something positive can have a ripple effect. For example, if a person starts donating supplies to a local food bank, it might seem like a small gesture at first. However, if they continue this habit regularly, others will notice. If the story reaches the local news, it could inspire the entire community to start contributing as well. This proves that consistent actions speak louder than words.

Another effective method is setting and achieving goals. People who have a clear plan often accomplish much more than those who do not. Imagine a student who wants to buy a new eighty-dollar video game but has no money. To reach this goal, they might start doing extra chores at home or helping their neighbors with yard work. By staying focused on their target, they eventually earn the money they need. This demonstrates to others that setting a goal is the first step toward success.

Furthermore, being motivated is essential for influencing others. It is difficult to inspire people if you lack energy or purpose. When you show enthusiasm and a strong work ethic, people are likely to follow your lead. Motivation is important because it reveals how much effort you are willing to put into a task, which encourages others to work just as hard.

Some might argue that a person’s general mood or behavior is the most important factor in influencing others. While a positive attitude helps, it does not show the practical steps needed to get things done. Therefore, the most effective way to impact people is by demonstrating clear actions, setting firm goals, and maintaining a high level of motivation.

In my English class today, my classmates were discussing the idea that first impressions are almost impossible to change. However, I disagree with this perspective. I believe it is unfair to judge someone based on a single moment because they might be going through a difficult time or facing a situation that affects their behavior.

One significant reason why first impressions can be misleading is that a person might be experiencing a hard period in their life. For example, moving to a new city and leaving behind friends and family can make someone feel very lonely and unhappy. I have personally experienced this many times because my family moves frequently for my parents' work. At one point, when I was told we would have to move every year, I felt so upset that I lost my interest in school and only wanted to distract myself. Right now, I am worried because my parents are looking for a new home again. I feel very comfortable at my current school because the teachers are helpful and I have made many wonderful friends. When someone is dealing with the stress of moving or losing a loved one, they may not act like their true selves.

Furthermore, people do not always treat everyone the same way, and misunderstandings can easily occur. I remember a time when I went to a party to meet a group of friends, but they ignored me and refused to speak to me. I eventually discovered that they were angry because of something they thought I had done. It turned out that my twin sister, who has a very different personality than mine, was actually responsible for the situation. Once I explained the confusion and told them about my sister, the problem was resolved, and we had a great time together for the rest of the night. This shows that a bad initial interaction can be corrected through communication.

Finally, some people may behave differently due to personal challenges or health conditions. A peer once told me about a boy who was usually very kind and helpful but would occasionally become aggressive or say hurtful things. He struggled to control his character because of a medical condition. Once the teachers explained his situation to the other students, everyone became more understanding and stopped judging him for his outbursts. This is a clear example of why we should not assume someone is a bad person just because of one negative encounter.

In conclusion, I believe that first impressions should not be final. Nobody is perfect, and everyone makes mistakes or faces challenges that influence how they act. If we are patient and look beyond the first meeting, we can see who a person really is.

Many people believe that first impressions are permanent and cannot be altered. However, based on my own experiences, I disagree with this idea. While first impressions happen quickly, they are not set in stone. I believe that we can change how we feel about someone over time, and I would like to explain my reasons for this perspective.

First of all, time is a crucial factor in how we perceive others. A first impression only lasts for a few seconds, but a relationship lasts much longer. For example, when you meet someone you are interested in, you might focus heavily on that initial moment. However, as you spend more time together, you begin to understand their true personality. The initial judgment you had in that first second often fades away as you gain more information. Therefore, time allows us to correct our initial thoughts and see who a person really is.

Secondly, we often judge people based on their facial expressions, which can be very misleading. I remember a situation from a year ago when I met a girl who looked very angry. Because of her expression, my first impression was that she was an unfriendly person. However, as I spent more time with her, I realized she wasn't mad at all; that was just her natural expression. My opinion of her changed completely as I moved past that first glance. This experience proved to me that our initial perceptions are often incorrect.

In life, time is something we cannot stop, but it is also something that helps us grow and change our minds. While we might remember the very first time we met someone, that memory does not have to define our entire relationship. We have the ability to move past those early feelings and develop a deeper, more accurate understanding of a person.

In conclusion, I believe it is definitely possible to change a first impression. Everything depends on the time we spend with others. Although you might never forget your first thought about a person, you can certainly update your opinion as you learn more about them. We always have the opportunity to change how we see the people around us.

Many people believe that the best way to impact others is by setting a personal example. However, I disagree with Albert Schweitzer’s claim that setting an example is the only way to influence people. In my view, influence can come from many different sources, such as the internet, our conversations, or our social environment.

One reason why examples are not the only method of influence is the power of peer pressure. For instance, if a young person attends a party where others are drinking alcohol, they might feel pressured to join in. Even if they do not know these people well or look up to them as role models, the simple desire to fit into the group can change their behavior.

Furthermore, the media plays a significant role in how we act. Television commercials frequently persuade people to purchase items they do not actually need. Many consumers spend money on products after seeing an advertisement, only to use them once and then forget about them. This demonstrates that media messaging is a powerful tool for influence that does not rely on a personal example.

Admittedly, personal examples are important, but we do not follow them blindly. For example, although I consider my mother a role model, I do not automatically copy everything she does. If she makes a mistake, I can choose not to repeat it. This shows that while examples exist, we still have the power to make our own decisions.

In conclusion, there are numerous ways to influence others beyond just being a role model. Whether it is through social pressure or advertising, influence is a complex process that happens in many different ways.

I believe Thomas Jefferson wrote his message to see if his people could be responsible for their own success. He wanted them to stop wasting time on minor things and instead focus on achieving their dreams. At that time, many people were afraid because they had previously been enslaved. This era, which included the presidency of Abraham Lincoln, highlights several reasons why these ideas were shared.

First, Jefferson wanted to see if people were actually following his advice. Many individuals do not think enough about what they can accomplish in life. Often, we spend too much time with others and fail to reach our own goals. People are sometimes too shy or scared to pursue their ambitions because they fear being judged or because they lack self-confidence. They assume their goals are too difficult to reach, so they never even try to succeed.

Second, a careful reading of his work reveals a need for more dedication. Many people lack the commitment required to make their lives better. For example, some students go to school only because their parents send them, without realizing the great opportunities they have for the future. By following Jefferson’s ideas, we can learn to work hard for a better life. We must focus on our future and study more to get the grades necessary to reach our goals.

Third, we currently have a lot of freedom to do what we want, but many people just want to have fun. Instead of working toward their dreams, they spend all their time at parties or hanging out with friends. If we only focus on socializing, we will never improve our lives. We need to show more commitment to our future ambitions rather than just seeking entertainment.

In conclusion, young people have the chance to be better and achieve more if they stay focused. We can prove our abilities by concentrating on our tasks and thinking clearly. We are not alone in this because our families support our future plans. Jefferson’s words provide the strength we need to keep moving forward and never give up on our dreams.

Have you ever considered whether spending more time at school would be a good idea? I personally believe that a longer school day would be very beneficial. It would allow students to learn more, finish their tasks, and even find time to relax. There are three main reasons why I think we should extend our time in the classroom.

This is a great advantage because it means you do not have to bring your work home with you. By finishing everything during the day, your evenings can be completely free.

Another reason involves our social lives. School can sometimes feel tedious, but being around friends makes it much more exciting. If we had more time, we could hang out with our peers and even work together on assignments. Having a "study buddy" makes it easier to complete difficult tasks and ensures that school is never boring.

Finally, more time at school can lead to better grades. If your marks are currently low, having extra time allows you to catch up on missing work or improve previous assignments. This extra opportunity to focus on your studies means your overall grades will likely increase because you have the time to fix mistakes.

To sum up, these are the reasons why I support having a longer school day. I believe it would help us both academically and socially. I hope you find these points convincing, but I understand if you have a different view. Either way, staying in school is important for every student.

If I had to explain to my teacher whether I prefer group projects or working individually, I would definitely choose to work alone. One major advantage of working by yourself is the ability to develop unique ideas that might not come up in a group setting. This independence often results in higher test scores and better grades than working with others. Additionally, group work can be very distracting. Instead of focusing on the assignment, students often end up chatting, using their phones, or playing games, which prevents them from finishing their tasks. By working alone, students can ensure they submit their assignments on time and avoid the risk of failing the class.

Another reason to prefer individual work is that some students are naturally quiet. For them, working alone is much more comfortable and ensures they do not fall behind because of the pressure to interact with unmotivated peers. Furthermore, group work is often unfair. Frequently, only one or two people do all the research and writing, while the rest of the group does nothing at all. These students just sit around and talk about things that are not related to the lesson instead of contributing.

There is also the issue of how parents react to poor academic performance. If a teacher calls home to say a student is failing, parents might blame the child's friends for being a bad influence. They may worry that their child is hanging out with the wrong people instead of focusing on schoolwork. To avoid these complications, it is better for students to be responsible for their own progress. In my opinion, working alone is the most effective way to learn. In life, we must earn our achievements through our own hard work rather than relying on the help of others.

I disagree with the idea that first impressions are permanent. If you give someone enough time and a second opportunity, they can easily change how others see them. People often make mistakes, and they should not be judged forever based on one bad moment.

The first reason to allow for a second chance is that everyone deserves the opportunity to improve. We have all experienced situations, such as a first date or a business meeting, where things did not go as planned. In those moments, we hope that people will look past our initial errors and remember us for our better qualities instead. By being patient, we can see what a person is actually like.

Secondly, this is very important in professional environments. If someone performs poorly during a significant meeting, their colleagues might think they are incompetent. However, if they are given another chance to prove themselves, they can show how much they have improved. This allows them to change the narrative so that others are impressed by how much they have changed since the first time.

Finally, first impressions matter in personal relationships, like meeting a partner’s parents. For example, if you make a mistake during dinner, a father might decide he does not want his daughter dating you. To fix this, you must visit again and show a better version of yourself. By doing this, you can change his mind and prove that you are a good person so that he no longer dislikes you.

In conclusion, we should always give people a second chance to correct their first impressions. This is the only way to truly understand someone's real character and see who they really are.

McDonald’s is a well-known fast-food chain where employees often work very hard for low wages. I believe that taking students to visit such a workplace would be a valuable lesson. It would show them the reality for people who do not have a good education or who did not take their studies seriously. By seeing this environment, students might realize that they do not want to end up in a similar position in the future.

When students observe people working quickly and tirelessly all day for a small paycheck, it might change their perspective on school. They will see that if they continue to play around in class instead of focusing, they could face a difficult career path. This experience could encourage them to put more effort into their schoolwork so they can achieve a more successful and better-paying job later in life.

Furthermore, many students do not realize how lucky they are to have an education. Some parents struggle to afford schooling, while others cannot attend at all. If students see the hard work required in low-skilled jobs, they might appreciate their education more. They should understand that having the chance to study is an advantage that should not be wasted. Those who do not take their education seriously often end up in jobs that pay very little.

Additionally, failing to pay attention in school is a waste of the money parents spend on their children's education. If a student chooses to goof off, they learn nothing, and their parents' investment is lost. Visiting a place like McDonald’s could be a wake-up call. It shows that taking school seriously leads to success, while ignoring your studies limits your opportunities.

In conclusion, I would organize a trip to a fast-food restaurant to help students understand the consequences of their choices. Seeing the hard work and low pay of the employees would likely motivate them to focus on their studies. It is a chance for them to change their mindset and work toward a successful future instead of ending up in a job they do not want.

There is a common debate about whether technology has a positive or negative impact on our lives. While some argue that it reduces human interaction, others believe it allows us to be much more efficient. In my opinion, technology is a beneficial tool that provides many advantages and serves as a significant help in our daily routines.

Today, most people lead very busy lives filled with work and various commitments. Students, for example, often have a heavy workload and part-time jobs. Technology makes these responsibilities much faster and easier to manage. In the past, completing a school project meant traveling to a library to find books, buying physical materials like pictures and colors, and finding transportation. This process was expensive and time-consuming. Now, thanks to digital tools, we can find everything we need instantly, which saves both time and money.

On the other hand, some people believe technology has negative effects, such as when family members use their cellphones at the dinner table instead of talking. While this can hurt relationships, technology also offers incredible ways to stay connected. It is a vital tool for communicating with friends and relatives who live in different places. Additionally, applications like Google Maps are extremely helpful when we need to find a specific address or navigate to a new location.

From my own experience, technology is essential for maintaining long-distance relationships. I have family and friends living in different states and countries. Although I miss them, we use video calls to see each other, which makes us very happy. For instance, my family always calls me on my birthday using FaceTime, and I do the same for my grandmother on her special day. Furthermore, my mother uses GPS to locate and pick up my father from work every day, which is a very practical use of these tools.

Beyond personal use, technology is vital in professional fields like science and medicine. Doctors use advanced machinery to save lives and discover cures for various illnesses. It also allows us to learn more about history and the world around us. Ultimately, the impact of technology depends on the mindset of the user and how they choose to apply it.

In conclusion, technology has a positive effect on our lives. It helps us feel closer to people in other countries and assists us in many different areas. If used correctly for the right reasons, it is a powerful resource that improves our overall quality of life.

Distance learning offers many advantages for today's students. Through the internet, individuals can easily access their lessons and communicate with their instructors from home. This method allows students to gain the same level of knowledge as they would in a traditional classroom but in a much more convenient way. One of the primary reasons this is beneficial is that it helps students avoid the serious issue of bullying.

Even though many teachers try to prevent bullying, it is often difficult to control every student's behavior. Some students simply do not follow the rules or care about the well-being of others. When a student’s life is already stressful due to family problems or a heavy workload, being bullied can have devastating consequences. In extreme cases, the pressure leads to severe depression or even suicide because students feel ignored or unsafe. Unfortunately, some teachers may overlook these problems because they find it easier than dealing with the parents or the school administration. Furthermore, bullies often do not realize that their actions can ruin lives or even lead to legal trouble and prison time.

Another significant problem in traditional schools is the negative influence of peers. Some teenagers pressure their classmates into dangerous habits like smoking, drinking, or using drugs. They often use emotional manipulation, telling their peers that they will lose their friendship or that secrets will be shared if they do not participate. This creates a toxic environment where students are afraid to say no. Additionally, many students go to school just to socialize or cause trouble, which distracts those who actually want to learn. For students who are constantly disruptive or uninterested in their studies, learning from home might be a better recommendation to prevent them from affecting the education of others.

Furthermore, distance learning is an excellent option for students who have responsibilities outside of school, such as part-time jobs or caring for siblings. Balancing a job with a traditional school schedule is often exhausting and stressful. Regular schools often have schedules filled with activities or long breaks that can waste time. In contrast, studying at home allows students to complete their work more efficiently, giving them more time for their other duties. It also reduces the pressure of rushing through assignments or exams. Another benefit is that students can get more rest. Waking up very early for school is difficult for many, and a lack of sleep often leads to poor concentration, lower grades, and general exhaustion.

In conclusion, having the choice to study from home can greatly improve a student's educational experience. It is a practical way to learn that provides the same information as a physical school but with fewer distractions and less stress. The internet offers various tools and apps that can make learning more engaging than sitting in a classroom for hours. By choosing online education, students can avoid negative social pressures and focus on their future. In the modern world, attending a physical building is no longer the only way to receive a quality education.

I disagree with Emerson’s perspective on individuality because it is impossible to focus only on yourself. Life should not be about "me, me, me" all the time. Instead, we must consider the people around us, including our parents, siblings, and grandparents. When friends or colleagues help us in difficult situations, we have a responsibility to care about them in return.

This is especially true when working in a team. If you choose to be selfish and ignore your teammates' questions or plans for a project, they will have a very negative opinion of you. To be successful, you must push yourself to contribute and help the group reach its goals. This attitude is also vital in a professional setting. In an office, employers watch how you behave and how you handle your responsibilities with others. They want to hire people who work well in a group. In conclusion, you should not overthink your own needs and forget about the people who support you.

While many teachers worry that summer vacation is too long and causes students to lose their focus or forget what they have learned, I disagree with this view. I believe that the current length of the summer break is necessary for several important reasons.

First, the long break gives students the opportunity to work and gain experience that they cannot get during the school year. When classes are in session, students are usually too busy with daily homework and studying for weekly tests to hold a job. Having three months off allows them to find employment, earn money, and develop professional skills. These experiences are very helpful when they apply for better jobs in the future and help them learn things that are not taught in a classroom.

Furthermore, students need a significant amount of time to rest after a stressful academic year. Constant studying and testing can be very tiring for the brain, and it is not healthy to work without a real break. Summer is the perfect time to relax and have fun. It allows students to go to the beach, travel to new locations, and spend quality time with their friends and family. The warm weather also makes it the best season for these outdoor activities, which helps students de-stress.

Another reason to keep the long summer break is that other vacations, such as those in the winter or spring, are often too short. These breaks usually only last one week, and teachers frequently assign projects or schedule exams for the day students return. Consequently, students spend their holidays studying instead of resting. Summer is the only time when they are completely free from school assignments and can truly enjoy their time off.

Some people might argue that having more frequent, shorter breaks throughout the year would be better. However, they should consider that these short breaks are rarely used for relaxation because of the heavy workload students still have to manage. Without a long summer vacation, students would never have a real chance to give their brains a rest.

In conclusion, summer vacation is the only extended period where students can truly relax and pursue activities they enjoy. It is essential for their well-being and personal growth. Therefore, the summer break should remain as it is so that students can return to school feeling refreshed and ready to learn.

The question of whether individuals should make their own choices or follow the advice of experts on important life matters is a significant topic. Some people believe it is better to let others decide for them because it removes the stress and worry of making a mistake. They feel more comfortable when an authority figure tells them exactly what to do.

However, many others disagree with this perspective. It is difficult to understand how a person who does not know you personally can make the right decisions for your life. In my opinion, I strongly disagree with letting others take control. It is my life, and I must learn how to manage it myself. Even when things are going badly, I believe it is my responsibility to handle my own problems and learn from them.

Of course, it is sometimes helpful to ask for an opinion, especially from someone older or more experienced. However, this should only be treated as a suggestion. You should never give someone else the authority to run your life or make final choices for you. They can offer a different perspective, but the ultimate decision must always be yours.

In conclusion, it is much better to take care of your own affairs, regardless of how challenging the situation might be. You are the only person who truly understands your own experiences and feelings. Therefore, I believe that everyone should be responsible for making their own decisions in life.

There is a well-known proverb that claims honesty is the best policy. I strongly agree with this statement because being truthful is the key to building strong friendships and living a meaningful life. While some people might misuse the truth, I believe that being honest generally brings people together and helps us do the right thing.

Trust is the foundation of any relationship, but it can be easily destroyed if someone is dishonest. For example, I am aware of a situation involving a car accident where a person was severely injured, yet the individual who caused the crash won the legal battle because they were not honest in court. This shows how damaging a lack of integrity can be. On the other hand, my father has shared stories about how witnesses helped catch criminals just by telling the police the truth about a robbery. These examples prove that even a small amount of honesty can lead to justice and help others.

Furthermore, being an honest person earns you respect. When you are known for telling the truth, it creates a positive environment and helps you form better connections with those around you. In contrast, being lied to feels like a deep betrayal. I remember when a neighbor’s house was robbed, and it was only because a witness was honest with the authorities that the thief was finally caught. It is also important to recognize that people can change; I once had a friend who was often dishonest but eventually realized the importance of the truth and improved his character. Personally, I have even gained new friendships simply by being a person who others can trust.

In conclusion, honesty should be practiced regardless of the circumstances. It ensures that your actions are justified and helps you maintain a high level of self-esteem, which is very beneficial in the long run. By choosing to be truthful, you create a better environment for yourself and everyone else, proving that honesty truly is the best path to follow.

I support Winston Churchill’s view that success is the ability to move from one failure to another without losing your drive. Although many people believe that failing will only lead to self-doubt and disappointment, I believe it is actually a vital part of personal growth. Failure provides us with new perspectives, helps us improve, and ultimately makes us more resilient than we were before.

Failure is an unavoidable part of life. While it is often seen as a negative outcome, it is actually a necessary step toward achieving our goals. It prepares us for more difficult challenges in the future. If we never experienced setbacks, we would never learn how to improve ourselves. Mistakes teach us that success is not easy and that we must put in significant effort to reach our objectives. In this way, every error is simply a tool for progress.

Furthermore, failing allows us to discover different ways to solve problems. When a specific method does not work, we learn what to avoid in the future. For instance, when I first started playing soccer, I struggled to kick the ball correctly. I failed many times because I only knew one technique. However, instead of quitting, I experimented with different foot positions to improve my power and accuracy. These failures taught me that there are many ways to reach a goal, rather than just one.

Additionally, failure builds inner strength. When you face a setback but refuse to give up, you become a more confident person. Overcoming obstacles ensures that you do not quit when things get difficult. Instead, you return to the task with more experience and the determination not to repeat the same errors. This process transforms you into a stronger version of yourself than you were before the mistake happened.

This mindset is well-illustrated by Thomas Edison. When asked how it felt to fail so many times while creating the light bulb, he famously replied that he had not failed, but rather that the project simply required many steps to be completed.

In conclusion, mistakes and failures are essential tools for learning. They offer us alternative paths to success and build the character needed to face future challenges. We should not be afraid to fail; instead, we should embrace it. Ultimately, the satisfaction of reaching a goal is much greater when we have overcome several obstacles along the way.

Many talented individuals work hard to find a career and build a better future. These people are often responsible and sure of their abilities, yet they are frequently rejected by employers simply because they lack professional experience. While many argue that experience is essential, I believe that success comes from persistence and a strong work ethic rather than just a history of previous jobs.

Many people have achieved great things without starting with a background in their field. For example, my father struggled to find work when I was a child. He had to support me and pay for my grandmother’s medical bills, but he had no prior experience. Instead of giving up, he kept trying. Today, he is one of the most successful journalists in Morocco. He is even better at his job than those who had years of training, proving that you just need to keep believing in yourself.

Furthermore, a worker does not necessarily need a long resume to be effective. What truly matters is being loyal, honest, and dedicated. An employee who works hard and treats others with respect can help a company grow and create a better atmosphere for everyone. These personal qualities are often more important than technical skills learned in the past.

This concept is not limited to traditional jobs; it also applies to sports and the arts. As the famous boxer Muhammad Ali once said, everyone begins as a beginner. When applying for a job, you should focus on showing the employer that you are the best candidate. Even if you lack experience, you must prepare thoroughly so you can demonstrate your knowledge. My father often says that inexperienced workers are usually the ones with the most energy and the best new ideas. Their positive attitude often makes them more valuable to a boss than older employees.

Unfortunately, many employers refuse to give people a chance to show what they can do. I have a friend from France who applied for a position as a teaching assistant in the United States. Even though she is a native speaker and could teach the language perfectly, schools would not hire her because she had never taught before. This is unfair because her natural ability would have helped the students learn easily. Employers should be more open-minded and look at a person's potential.

Ultimately, having no experience should not stop you from reaching your goals. If you have confidence and work hard, you can succeed in any role. Employers who only value experience are missing out on great talent. What matters most is the work you are going to do in the future, not what you have done before. If you maintain a positive attitude, you can reach the top of your field, just as my father and my friend have done.

Initial opinions of others are nearly impossible to modify. Since we usually only have a person's physical appearance to judge when we first meet, these early thoughts become deeply rooted and are rarely updated.

First, humans instinctively categorize others based on how they look. For example, if a student meets a peer who appears physically weak, they might assume the boy is bad at sports. Even if the boy performs excellently in a match, the student may still struggle to see him as an athlete because the original image of his "unhealthy" body is so strong in their mind.

Furthermore, people often cling to their first impressions because they are personal beliefs. Consider a man who seems very quiet and unwilling to socialize. Others might decide to ignore him based on this initial vibe. Even if he later reveals that he actually enjoys talking, people may find it hard to forget their first idea of him as a shy person, which keeps them from interacting with him naturally.

However, it is possible to change a first impression by building a relationship. For instance, a man might look large and angry, causing others to fear him. If a student takes the time to speak with him and finds out he is actually friendly, the student's perspective will shift. This change makes the relationship much more comfortable and positive.

Additionally, showing a clear change in behavior can alter how others see you. If a student who used to be mean starts being helpful and kind, their friends might eventually change their minds. This transformation can lead to stronger friendships and a more positive environment for everyone involved.

In conclusion, while it is possible to change how people see us through effort and interaction, it remains a very difficult task. Because first impressions are so stubborn, we should be careful not to judge others too quickly based on them.

In my opinion, allowing students to work from home is not a good idea. Many young people would likely take advantage of this situation just to avoid the early morning school schedule. While some students are very hardworking, many others would choose to stay home simply because they do not feel like waking up early. Because of this, I believe that traditional schooling is a much better option for students than remote learning.

One of the main problems is that students might misuse their time at home. They might claim to be doing their schoolwork, but they would probably end up sleeping and delaying their tasks until later. Although school can be difficult, the physical environment provides access to teachers and staff who are always there to help. While online programs do offer some support, many students are visual learners who need an instructor right in front of them to understand the material. Additionally, while some people enjoy working independently, many others learn more effectively when they can participate in group activities or work with a partner in a classroom.

I am not saying that online work has no benefits at all, but I believe that being in school is much easier for most. Many students would not actually benefit from being at home because they would be distracted or spend their time goofing off instead of studying. There are also other practical issues to consider, such as the fact that not every student has a reliable internet connection. In a school building, everyone has access to the resources they need to succeed. Furthermore, there are safety concerns regarding the people students might encounter online.

Ultimately, I believe that learning at school is better than working from home. In a classroom, students have a real chance to finish their work, whereas at home, they are more likely to just sleep. Being in a school environment is more helpful because there is always someone available to provide guidance. While some may succeed online, most people perform better when they have a teacher right there to support them.

Many people believe that first impressions are permanent and impossible to alter, but I disagree with this view. In my opinion, people are constantly changing, and a single initial meeting is not enough to define a person’s true character.

He started smiling more and became much more social, which totally transformed my initial opinion of him. Another example is a teacher who appears very kind and patient during the first few days of class. In this situation, the positive first impression disappears because the teacher’s daily behavior has changed.

Furthermore, a first impression does not truly define who you are. It is often said that a first meeting is like the cover of a book, which does not always show what is actually written inside. For instance, some of my friends confessed that they did not like me when we first met. They thought I was an angry person who only talked to a small group of people. If that person takes the time to get to know you better, they will eventually see your real personality and realize that the first impression was wrong.

To conclude, first impressions are not permanent because they do not represent a person's whole identity. Since people can change and initial meetings are often influenced by temporary moods, it takes more than one encounter to truly understand someone. Therefore, first impressions are frequently corrected as we learn more about others.
